systems.name: Star Chart
systems.description: The Star Chart uses Celestal Spheres to unlock power ups for your Trovian.
systems.detail: Use a Constellation Key to reset the Star Chart. This will return any used Celestial Spheres and remove any abilities gained from the Star Chart.

systems.name: Depths of the Angler
systems.description: The Depths are an alien place of power, mystery, and predators. Those that can master the Depths can wield it's power.

nodes.name: Depths of the Angler
nodes.description: The Depths stir and power is available for those willing to seize it.
nodes.detail: Meet with Murkwater Mark under in the Hub to gain the Aura of the Angler and begin your delve into the Depths.

nodes.name: Aura of the Angler
nodes.description: Murkwater Mark can reveal how to channel the power of the Depths, but he demands Marks of the Angler for some reason.
nodes.detail: You have a chance to gain Marks of the Angler while fishing.

nodes.name: Basic Recipes
nodes.description: You can only catch fish as cunning as your lure, but the Depths can teach you the weaknesses of your prey.
nodes.detail: Teaches how to craft some basic recipes at the Nautical Assembler.

nodes.name: Freshwater Fran's Orders I
nodes.description: Freshwater Fran is looking to capture the fish that have escaped the Depths, and she's willing to pay.
nodes.detail: Brings Freshwater Fran to the Hub, who sells Beginner's Special Orders. Special Orders are Trovian Agency fishing Adventures.

nodes.name: Beginner's Seafood Cookbook
nodes.description: A cookbook lost to the Depths now rises to the surface.
nodes.detail: Unlocks Beginner's Seafood recipes at the Angler's Grill.

nodes.name: Kitchen Porter
nodes.description: Rule 1: If you can't stand the heat get out of the kitchen.
nodes.detail: Reduces the cost of Beginner's Seafood recipes coooked at the Angler's Grill.

nodes.name: Junior Chef
nodes.description: Rule 25: Normally it's bad to undercook food, but with fish you can just call it sushi.
nodes.detail: Increases the duration of Beginner's Seafood recipes cooked at the Angler's Grill.

nodes.name: Recipe: Basic Canned Fish Conversion
nodes.description: Fish can rot quickly, but canned properly it can last for nearly an eternity.
nodes.detail: Unlocks a recipe at the Angler's Grill to convert Basic Canned Fish.

nodes.name: Fragment of the Depths
nodes.description: A lost fragment of a forgotten being.
nodes.detail: Grants a Caprian Dragon Egg Fragment.

nodes.name: Journeyman's Seafood Cookbook
nodes.description: New recipes begin to manifest in the ancient cookbook.
nodes.detail: Unlocks Journeyman's Seafood recipes at the Angler's Grill.

nodes.name: Station Chef
nodes.description: Rule 78: Fish can be tempremental, the key is focus.
nodes.detail: Reduces the cost of Journeyman's Seafood recipes coooked at the Angler's Grill.

nodes.name: Deputy Chef
nodes.description: Rule 4: The joy isn't cooking for yourself, it's cooking for others.
nodes.detail: Increases the duration of Journeyman's Seafood recipes cooked at the Angler's Grill.

nodes.name: Recipe: Select Canned Fish Conversion
nodes.description: A tasty treat today, tomorrow, or next year!
nodes.detail: Unlocks a recipe at the Angler's Grill to convert Select Canned Fish.

nodes.name: Ally: Tiny Deltalith Crab
nodes.description: How'd a little crab manage to hide away in this Deltalith?
nodes.detail: Unlocks the Tiny Deltalith Crab ally.

nodes.name: Acceleration
nodes.description: Smooth sailing and favorable winds.
nodes.detail: Increases your Acceleration by +5.

nodes.name: Expert's Seafood Cookbook
nodes.description: Blotchy ink in the cookbook's final pages finally begins to fade, revealing lost secrets.
nodes.detail: Unlock's Expert Seafood recipes at the Angler's Grill.

nodes.detail: Reduces the cost of Expert's Seafood recipes coooked at the Angler's Grill.

nodes.name: Recipe: Premium Canned Fish Conversion
nodes.description: The best of the best. No fish fishier, no scales scalier!
nodes.detail: Unlocks a recipe at the Angler's Grill to convert Premium Canned Fish.

nodes.name: Recipe: Master Angler's Fishing Net (Weekly)
nodes.description:
A net capable of catching many fish all at once.
Captures 5 fish when thrown into any pool or fishable liquid.

Requires an active Lure.
nodes.detail: Unlocks the Master Angler's Fishing Net (Weekly) recipe at the Nautical Assembler. If you already have a Bubble with this upgrade then you are allowed to craft an additional net weekly.

nodes.name: Acceleration
nodes.description: Smooth sailing and favorable winds.
nodes.detail: Increases your Acceleration by +5.

nodes.name: Recipe: Premium Canned Fish (Weekly)
nodes.description: Canned rare fish.\n\nUsed to cook food at the Angler's Grill.
nodes.detail: Unlocks the Premium Canned Fish (Weekly) recipe at the Angler's Grill.

nodes.name: Recipe: Donation - Canned Fish
nodes.description: Murkwater Mark loves his canned fish, but he loves Marks of the Angler more.
nodes.detail: Unlocks the recipe to donate Marks of the Angler at the Nautical Assembler for Premium Canned Fish.

nodes.name: Recipe: Basic Lures

systems.name: Rune Anvil
systems.description:
Runecrafters can unlock the secrets of Runecrafting by activating Runes.
Upgrade up to two complete Runes to specialize in Runecrafting.
systems.detail: Select a Node to begin or you can reset your Progression Runes below.

nodes.name: Runesmith
nodes.description: Runecrafters must first fully unlock this rune before branching into other paths.
nodes.detail: The first Rune all Runecrafter must learn on the path to mastery over Depth Carving.

nodes.name: Resolve
nodes.description: Unlocks the 'Unbreakable Runes' effect for DEPTH CARVER Runecrafters (300 Skill), which allows Runecrafters to prevent their Runes from breaking for 1 hour.
nodes.detail: Break so that you may reforge.

nodes.name: Perception
nodes.description: Allows Rune Fragments to be found from creatures in The Depths delve biome.
nodes.detail: Always keep an eye out. Always.

nodes.name: Brittle Runes I
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of the Hardened Rune buff--gained from breaking runes--from 60s to 53s.
nodes.detail: Each crack reveals truth.

nodes.name: Discovery
nodes.description: Ore Runes now have an additional chance to grant Miner's Trove, plus a chance to grant Encrusted Runic Trunks when mining Deepstone, Lichenstone, or Runic Ore.
nodes.detail: So many treasures in the Depths...

nodes.name: Brittle Runes II
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of the Hardened Rune buff--gained from breaking runes--from 53s to 46s.
nodes.detail: Fractures reveal what lies beneath.

nodes.name: Devotion
nodes.description: Doubles the duration of Metallic and Rippling Runes.
nodes.detail: Many worship the Depth Lords wishing for salvation.

nodes.name: Brittle Runes III
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of the Hardened Rune buff--gained from breaking runes--from 46s to 40s.
nodes.detail: Be wary of truth in the Depths, knowledge can corrupt.

nodes.name: Repetition
nodes.description: Shining Runes have a 5% chance to trigger an additional time.
nodes.detail: The Depths promise great rewards for those that survive them.

nodes.name: Zephyr Seeker
nodes.description: Zephyr Seekers find greater rewards as they battle the Depths.
nodes.detail: The Zephyr value the material above all. They horde wealth and hunt those that plumb the deaths with endless fury.

nodes.name: Swift Rune
nodes.description: Unlocks the Swift Rune recipe.
nodes.detail:
Increases your Attack Speed by 30% and movement speed by 10.

The Zephyr strike quickly and leave none to tell the tale.

nodes.name: Zephyr Rune
nodes.description: Unlocks the Zephyr Rune recipe.
nodes.detail:
Breaks when you take damage from acid, making you immune for 10 seconds.

In the battles of the Depths, the Zephyr Carvers protect their warriors from the Abyssal acids with these runes.

nodes.name: Harvest Rune
nodes.description: Unlocks the Harvest Rune recipe.
nodes.detail:
Breaks upon completing a dungeon, granting a buff that gives a chance to obtain Encrusted Runic Trunk when harvesting resources unique to Long Shade difficulty (15).

The Zephyr's greatest secret to their great wealth, they create their own luck.

nodes.name: Abundance Rune
nodes.description: Unlocks the Abundance Rune recipe.
nodes.detail:
Breaks upon completing a dungeon, spawning a bonus chest.

The Zephyr's second best secret to their great wealth, they just find more.

nodes.name: Zephyr Breaker
nodes.description: Runes grant essence when they break.
nodes.detail: The Zephyr hoard all three essences, the question is for what?

nodes.name: Zephyr Forged
nodes.description: Runes grant additional Rune Fragments when they break.
nodes.detail: The Zephyr waste nothing.

nodes.name: Zephyr Tactics
nodes.description: You have a chance to find Encrusted Runic Trunks when you defeat minor Depth enemies.
nodes.detail: Zephyr Teachings: Evade your enemies, first, crush those you can't.

nodes.name: Zephyr Zeal
nodes.description: You have a chance to find Encrusted Runic Trunks when you defeat major Depth enemies.
nodes.detail: The more the Zephyr believe, the harder they fight.

nodes.name: Zephyr Cunning
nodes.description: Grants a chance to find Encrusted Runic Trunks when you open Surfaced Depths Caches and Runic Depths Vaults.
nodes.detail: The Zephyr excel at cracking runic Vaults open.

nodes.name: Pyric Soldier
nodes.description: Pyric Soldiers employ the power of Runes for what they believe their true purpose is, destruction.
nodes.detail: Pyric Teachings: Burn, rend, tear, do what you must to survive. If you can't survive, fight even harder.

nodes.name: Focus Rune
nodes.description: Unlocks the Focus Rune recipe.
nodes.detail:
Breaks when you spend all of your energy, replenishing your energy to full.

The first wave of flames is bad, the second wave is even worse.

nodes.name: Pyric Rune
nodes.description: Unlocks the Pyric Rune recipe.
nodes.detail:
Breaks when you use your ultimate ability, creating a large fire around you burning your enemies for 10 seconds.

Pyric fury burns so hot it can ignite flames under water.

nodes.name: Pyric Breaker
nodes.description: Runes that break increase your damage by 5%.
nodes.detail: Pyric Runesmiths imbue their fury into their craft.

nodes.name: Pyric Drive
nodes.description: Increases the duration of Condemn and Fury Rune buffs.
nodes.detail: The Pyric funnel their rage into their combat.

nodes.name: Pyric Resolve
nodes.description: You gain an increase of 5% to your Health Regen and Stability while equipping a rune.
nodes.detail: Pyric Teachings: Runes grant power. Through power the Pyric shall conquer.

nodes.name: Condemn Rune
nodes.description: Unlocks the Condemn Rune recipe.
nodes.detail:
Breaks when you're hit by an attack that would kill you, triggering a rage that increases your damage by 20%.

The only thing the Pyric fight for more than winning is against defeat.

nodes.name: Pyric Veteran
nodes.description: You gain an increase of 5% to your Critical Hit Rate and Damage while equipping a rune.
nodes.detail: Pyric Soldiers don't last long, fear the old fish.

nodes.name: Pyric Rage
nodes.description: Runes that break trigger a burning flame that damage enemies around you for 5 seconds.
nodes.detail: The best Pyric Soldiers can manifest their rage to scald those around them.

nodes.name: Fury Rune
nodes.description: Unlocks the Fury Rune recipe.
nodes.detail:
Breaks sometimes when you deal damage. In addition hitting can trigger one of three Fury Rune buffs, increasing Critical Hit Chance, Critical Hit Damage, and overall Damage.

Pyric Soldiers only grow stronger as they fight.

nodes.name: Abyssal Smith
nodes.description: Abyssal Smiths focus on the craft of carving runes. They endure attacks of the Zephyr and Pyric through determination.
nodes.detail: The Abyssal waters claim all.

nodes.name: Restoration
nodes.description: Unlocks the Restoration Rune recipe.
nodes.detail:
Breaks after defeating an enemy, restoring a charge of your equipped flask.

Abyssal teachings use healing to outlast their enemies.

nodes.name: Abyssal Rune
nodes.description: Unlocks the Abyssal Rune recipe.
nodes.detail:
Breaks when you would take damage from lava or Jellous's flames but grants immunity to the damage from lava and Jellous's flames.

The Pyric can burn the water, but not the Abyssal.

nodes.name: Replenishment Rune
nodes.description: Unlocks the Replenishment Rune recipe.
nodes.detail:
Breaks when you're hit by an attack that would kill you, reducing your cooldowns by 33%.

Abyssal Smiths stop their work only to sleep and defend. They even eat at their anvils.

nodes.name: Endurance Rune
nodes.description: Unlocks the Endurance Rune recipe.
nodes.detail:
Breaks sometimes when you take damage. Taking Damage can also trigger an Endurance effect, reducing damage taken, increasing Maximum Health, and granting Stability.

Abyssal Teachings: Endure and outlast.

nodes.name: Abyssal Breaker
nodes.description: Runes that break grant an increase to your Stability, Maximum Health, and Health Regen.
nodes.detail: Abyssal waters protect those that emprace them.

nodes.name: Abyssal Slatesmith
nodes.description: You have a chance to craft extra rune slates.
nodes.detail: The greatest slatesmiths are coveted. Every artist desires the perfect palette.

nodes.name: Abyssal Scribe
nodes.description: You have a chance to craft extra leaflets.
nodes.detail: Texts don't last long under water, best to read them quickly.

nodes.name: Abyssal Runesmith
nodes.description: You have a chance to craft extra runes.
nodes.detail: In times of great need quality wane in favor of quantity.

nodes.name: Master Abyssal Smith
nodes.description:
Unlocks recipes to craft Rune Slates directly for Depth Essences at the Depths Runic Master rank.
Also unlocks all Zephyr and Pyric Rune crafting.
nodes.detail: Master Abyssal Runesmiths are the most valuable resource in the Depths.

Unlock nodes for one-time rewards. Upgrade up to six (6) nodes to increase your power.

nodes.description: Increases the amount of Gearcrafter's Vault given by Vaunted Vaulter I by 2.
